name: "Pretty Boy" Duncan
summary: Catelyn the Blade has lost the dagger her father asked her to return. She wants it back from Pretty Boy Duncan before she helps you further.

sections.title: A Pirate's Grievance
sections.body: Catelyn the Blade has left the mages and their dusty tomes behind. Ansirem's Key led you to her, but she cannot give you the dagger her father asked her to return. A Bloodsail Buccaneer took it. Until her blade is recovered, Catelyn will hand over nothing else.

sections.title: The Stolen Steel
sections.body: Pretty Boy Duncan struck Catelyn unconscious and took the knife she carried in a fight. She relies on that weapon. Now she insists on getting that very blade back from the buccaneer before she helps you further.

faq.answer: Pretty Boy Duncan is a Bloodsail Buccaneer near Booty Bay. He defeated Catelyn the Blade, knocked her unconscious, and took her dagger.

faq.q: Why does Catelyn want her dagger back?
faq.answer: Catelyn relies on her knife in a fight and will not settle for another. She wants the dagger Duncan took back before helping anyone searching for her.

faq.q: Why did Catelyn run away from home?
faq.answer: Catelyn left her family to escape a dull life reading old books among rigid, aged mages. She refused to spend her days that way.

faq.q: Where does this step fit into the search?
aliases: what leads to pretty boy duncan
faq.answer: This encounter follows the recovery of Ansirem's Key and comes before the search uncovers The Curse of the Tides.

angles.text: As a Mage, you may hear Catelyn mock arcane scholars. She says she fled home to avoid spending her days among stuffy, grey-haired spellcasters.
